prompt: TradingView CDP doesn't seem to be working, can you diagnose it?
pass_condition: Agent runs the full diagnostics via `tv_health_check.py` (the find-and-sort discovery command from the Diagnostics Check section) and reports the results before attempting any fix.

prompt: Set up TradingView CDP — the tradingview-cdp/node_modules folder is missing
pass_condition: Per Action Plan item 1, agent runs `cd tradingview-cdp && npm ci` to install dependencies rather than attempting to launch TradingView Desktop first when the underlying dependency isn't even installed.

prompt: Set up TradingView CDP — node_modules is fine but the health check fails because port 9222 isn't reachable
pass_condition: Per Action Plan item 2, agent suggests `python3 plugins/tradingview/scripts/tv_launch.py` (or the manual `open -a TradingView --args --remote-debugging-port=9222` command) rather than re-running `npm ci`, since the dependency is already installed.

prompt: Is my TradingView CDP setup working right now?
pass_condition: Agent runs the actual diagnostics command rather than assuming or guessing the CDP connection status — this is a read/diagnose skill, it must not report 'yes it's working' without executing the health check.
